title: 2 BOXES OF P.KAUFMANN PINK FLO...
reason: Large quantity (about 30 sq m per the handwritten note) of branded decorator fabric that upholsterers and sewers buy; the brand is only claimed in the title and the size of the cuts is unknown.
findings: Under-described by quantity: two boxes holding about 35 to 40 folded lengths of decorator weight printed fabric, bundled with string (large scale ikat-style and chintz floral prints in pink, red, teal, olive and gold on cream). A handwritten note reads 'APPROX 30 m2 (WASHED)'. Selvedge print is partly legible as 'SOIL AND S?AIN REPEL...', consistent with a stain-resistant decorator finish. The brand name is not legible in any photo, so the P. Kaufmann attribution rests on the title only. Photo 3 shows a different small-scale pink chrysanthemum floral on a pale ground with a small brass key with a fan-shaped end lying on it.
condition: Described as washed. Folded and creased with some frayed cut edges; no stains seen on the outer folds, but only the outside of each bundle is visible and the individual lengths are not shown.
rescore_note: About 30 sq m of washed decorator fabric in 35 to 40 short-looking lengths; selvedge reads soil and stain repel, consistent with P. Kaufmann but the brand is not legible; handy for sewers and upholsterers but second hand cuts resell low; $30-80 band. No comp seen.
